rule: AGENTS.md 7.1: exactly one content learning goal; independent routines split.

atomicityCandidates.planning: One coherent staffing-plan analysis. Quantity/qualification/time and two perspectives are aspects of the same plan. Correct count alone without qualification/timing/perspectives does not establish it.
atomicityCandidates.leadership: Decision/coordination/feedback rules and their case-bound discussion form one leadership-principle assessment.
atomicityCandidates.development: Learning need, implementation, transfer and conditions form one development-strategy judgment.

whyLeadershipAndDevelopmentAreSeparate.fullCounterexampleA: A learner correctly prefers joint handover decisions for an experienced team and changes to close direction for inexperienced temporary staff, explaining both perspectives and limits. They nevertheless declare an unavailable mentor programme successful and retain its old transfer forecast. Leadership is shown; development is not.
whyLeadershipAndDevelopmentAreSeparate.fullCounterexampleB: A learner correctly rejects the unstaffed mentoring plan, explains practice/feedback transfer and selects a feasible alternative with monitoring. They nevertheless call decentralised authority unrestricted freedom and fail to discuss coordination or accountability. Development is shown; leadership is not.
